svg.aria-label: How a ticket runs: a request from GitHub, Feishu or the TUI passes a gate, becomes a ticket, runs on a worker on a device with the right harness, and the answer goes back where it was asked.
svg.title: How a ticket runs: a request from GitHub, Feishu or the TUI passes a gate, becomes a ticket, runs on a worker on a device with the right harness, and the answer goes back where it was asked.

g.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.text: only people allowed to ask get through, before any model sees it
a model routes it: a new ticket, an existing one, a stop, or nothing
runs on a device with the right harness, in its own worktree
Swarm's own loop, Claude Code, Codex, Kimi Code or OpenCode
answers where it was asked; later messages there go to the same worker
